text:
alex.k: Heads up — Nimbus SI asked if we can bundle a Datadog dashboard tile + OTLP snippet for their GCP Marketplace listing. They want a small demo that shows traces from our Private deployment -> Datadog APM flow.

maria.p: That sounds doable. What are the must-haves for the tile?

alex.k: Nimbus wants 1) a trace flamegraph sample, 2) a latency heatmap, 3) a sample log panel with model inference ids. Also they want an OTLP example config and a note about sampling defaults.

samir: For OTLP we should provide an example receiver config and a minimal python instrumented client. Keep sampling 1% by default for demo, with instructions to flip to 100% in staging.

tanvi: Can we rely on the hosted OTLP endpoint or should Nimbus use a proxy collector for air-gapped customers?

alex.k: Provide both. Example: show direct OTLP to Datadog for cloud customers and a collector snippet for on-prem. Also call out intake key handling (KMS/HSM) for Private.

maria.p: Drafting the tile assets — do we have a canonical metric/query for model p99 latency? Is it `redwood.inference.latency_p99`?

samir: We export `inference.latency_ms` with labels {model, route, shard}. p99 query: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))` — show both promql and Datadog equivalent.

tanvi: Nimbus ops asked for a runbook step for fallback routing when GPU pool is saturated. Should be included in the tile notes.

alex.k: Agreed. Add a short runbook snippet: how to toggle fallback to smaller model variant (policy id: ff_fallback_01) and how to monitor error rate spike.

nimbus-ops: Quick note — Nimbus will want the demo to use GCP N2A + Aurora GPUs and show trace metadata for node id so our SI can correlate infra.

maria.p: Pushed a draft tile json to the partner repo: https://git.redwood/integrations/nimbus/datadog-tile-demo — please review.

samir: Quick OTLP receiver example to include in docs:

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: ${DATADOG_API_KEY} # instruct to use secret manager
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

alex.k: Nice. Also include this python snippet for sending spans (super tiny):

```python
from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.exporter.otlp.proto.grpc.trace_exporter import OTLPSpanExporter
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import BatchSpanProcessor

provider = TracerProvider()
exporter = OTLPSpanExporter(endpoint="https://otlp.datadoghq.com:443", headers=("DD-API-KEY", os.environ.get("DD_API_KEY")))
provider.add_span_processor(BatchSpanProcessor(exporter))
trace.set_tracer_provider(provider)
tracer = trace.get_tracer(__name__)
with tracer.start_as_current_span("inference.request"):
    pass
```

tanvi: We're good to show sample dashboard queries for latency, error rate, and token throughput. Add a note about pseudonymizing prompt text in logs for privacy.

maria.p: Timeline ask from marketing: Nimbus wants joint announce copy + screenshot by next Tue (embargo Mon EOD). Can engineering deliver the tile + runbook by Monday morning?

samir: We'll prioritize. I'll put a small checklist in the PR: 1) OTLP example, 2) Dashboard queries (promql + datadog), 3) Runbook snippet, 4) Demo dataset and how to scrub PII.

alex.k: Assigning owners: samir -> tech assets; tanvi -> runbook & fallback policy; maria -> partner liaison + screenshot prep. @dd-bot can you schedule a reminder on Friday to sync with Nimbus?

dd-bot: Reminder set for 3412345800: Partnerships sync with Nimbus — confirm demo artifacts and embargo timing.

maria.p: One more ask from Nimbus — they want a short section on security posture (KMS integration + SOC2 mention). Add a one-paragraph blurb in the tile notes.

samir: Will add. Also flagging: we should test trace propagation across our routing (dedicated -> fallback) so the flamegraph doesn't break when we switch variants. I'll run that test in staging Friday.

tanvi: If any of you need me to run the runbook dry-run with Nimbus ops, ping me after the PR lands.

alex.k: Great — let's aim to have PR ready by Sunday night. If blockers surface, post here. :thumbsup:
